factions.name: Rustline Crews
factions.description: Loose crews running the lower levels: protection, chop shops, turf wars. Loyal if you're useful.

factions.name: Aegis Meridian Security
factions.description: Private security contracted by the arcology corps. They pay well and remember everything.

factions.name: Free Contractors
factions.description: Freelance guns, couriers and fixers' muscle. Respect competence, hate drama.

factions.name: The Undermarket
factions.description: Smugglers, chop-dealers and ghost fabricators. Everything has a price, including you.

factions.name: Civic Medical Board
factions.description: The licensing board. Officially hunting unlicensed rippers. Unofficially, inspectors have bills too.
